response: {"headline": "STABILITY trial of darapladib failed to reduce MACE in stable coronary heart disease (HR 0.94), consistent with a non-causal Lp-PLA2 target.", "summary": "The STABILITY trial randomized 15,828 patients with chronic coronary heart disease to darapladib 160 mg or placebo, targeting a 15.5% relative risk reduction with 90% power and 1,500 planned primary endpoint events over a median 3.51 years follow-up. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke (HR 0.94). Genetic evidence shows no causal link between PLA2G7 and coronary heart disease (Open Targets score 0.0), and the calculator predicts no benefit (expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0%). Despite robust Lp-PLA2 inhibition of ~66% in phase 2, the biomarker reduction did not translate to clinical benefit. Safety was acceptable with no major imbalance in serious adverse events. Confidence in the failure assessment is high.", "key_evidence": ["15,828 participants randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00799903 STABILITY)", "Primary endpoint: composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "1,500 planned primary endpoint events (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "90% power to detect 15.5% RRR (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "Median follow-up 3.51 years (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00799903 STABILITY)", "Observed HR 0.94 (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)", "Study did not meet primary endpoint (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)", "No major imbalance in serious adverse events (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)", "Lp-PLA2 inhibition ~66% in phase 2 (Peripheral artery disease, biomarkers, and darapladib)", "PLA2G7 genetic association score 0.0 (opentargets:PLA2G7)", "Calculator expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0.0% (calculator)"], "what_would_change_this": "Only large-scale Mendelian randomization studies specifically testing Lp-PLA2 activity as a causal mediator for MACE, or trials of other Lp-PLA2 inhibitors showing benefit, could challenge the conclusion that the target is not causal.", "readthrough_note": "The SOLID-TIMI 52 trial in acute coronary syndrome (NCT01000727) tested the same target in a different population; its results would inform whether the failure is population-specific or target-wide."}
